releaseNotes:
• Floating HUD Pill Auto-Dismiss & Tap-to-Dismiss: Added a 3.5s auto-timeout to link detection pulses and 14s timeout to resolving states, preventing the HUD pill from staying stuck beneath camera cutouts. Any tap on the pill now instantly dismisses it.
• Closed-Loop State Synchronization: Emits error and idle state notifications when post resolution fails, maintaining perfect synchronization between the floating button and Island HUD.
• Resolver Diagnostics & WebView Resumption: Integrated AppLogger across all resolution tiers and enabled explicit timer resumption in headless WebViews.
• 1-Tap App Sharing: Easily share InstaSave with friends directly from Settings.
